tasks.description: Create seccomp filter profiles and AppArmor enforce modes on Kubernetes control-plane nodes.

tasks.title: Consistent hashing ring with virtual nodes for partition balance
tasks.description: Implement Maglev or Ketama consistent ring to prevent thundering herd when cache nodes reboot.

tasks.title: Gossip protocol failure detector with phi-accrual thresholds
tasks.description: Accurately detect unresponsive cache nodes over unstable WAN connections without false positives.
